title: Accounts are issued by the laboratory
purpose: This deployment does not offer public account registration.
summary: Accounts are issued by the laboratory. There is no public sign-up.

tasks.title: Get an account
steps: Ask the laboratory to issue a staff or client account for you.

tasks.title: Sign in with an issued account
steps: Select the Smart Roots name at the top to go to sign in.

good_to_know: This page has no registration form or sign-up action.
Staff and client accounts are both issued by the laboratory.
The Smart Roots name at the top returns to the application.

sections.title: Closed registration
paragraphs: The page displays Sign Up Closed without a registration form. Public signup is closed by the account adapter. Ask the laboratory to issue a staff or client account. The branding link returns to the application; this page has no sign-up action.
